Troubleshooting: Studio & UI ​

1. Layout Overlapping on Mobile ​

Symptom: The Script Panel overlaps the Visual Stage on small screens. Cause: You may have forced "Split View" on a screen that is too small to accommodate it side-by-side. Solution:

  • Rotate your device to Landscape mode.
  • Or, switch back to Tabbed View using the layout toggle in the Studio Toolbar.

2. Workflow Stepper Stuck ​

Symptom: The automation pipeline pauses and the "Next Action" button vanishes. Cause: You have hit a Human-in-the-Loop approval gate (e.g., waiting for you to approve the generated images). Solution: Look for a glowing "Approve" button. The orchestrator will not proceed to video stitching until you explicitly approve the outputs of the previous stage.

3. Keyboard Shortcuts Not Working ​

Symptom: Pressing Spacebar to play the timeline doesn't work. Cause: Your cursor is likely focused inside a text input field (like the scene editor or prompt box). Solution: Click anywhere on the empty background of the Studio to remove focus from the text fields, then try the shortcut again.

4. UI Doesn't Reflect Backend State ​

Symptom: Another user cloned your script, but you don't see it in the Project View. Cause: The frontend relies on real-time Firestore listeners, which can occasionally disconnect if your network drops. Solution: Hard refresh the browser (Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + R). Browser refreshes are fully supported and will now persist your active project and script state via the URL so you won't lose your place.
